brands.label: Morrow Motion — footwear & activewear
brands.summary: An energetic online sneaker and activewear brand for everyday movement.

profile.tone: Energetic, inclusive, practical; confident without hype
profile.description: Fictional direct-to-consumer footwear and activewear brand built around everyday movement, from a morning commute to a casual gym session. The brand emphasizes versatile styling and straightforward product information. Online-only test business; no physical store locations or real customer endorsements.
profile.target_audience: US adults aged 20–40 who combine work, casual fitness and city life. Budget-conscious shoppers seeking versatile outfits. Inclusive of different fitness levels; avoid athletic-performance promises or body-shaming language.
profile.products: Dayline low-top lifestyle sneaker: $89 USD, off-white and slate, synthetic upper, rubber outsole, US sizes 5–12. Form crew tee: $28 USD, cotton blend, charcoal and cream, sizes XS–XXL. Carry bottle: $22 USD, 600 mL stainless steel, navy; do not claim thermal performance.
past_taglines: Made for the plans between your plans.
Keep the outfit simple. Keep moving.

brands.label: Juniper Cup — coffee & pantry
brands.summary: A welcoming online coffee and brewing-accessory shop with a calm editorial voice.

profile.description: Fictional online coffee shop offering approachable coffee blends and simple home-brewing accessories. Focuses on enjoyable daily rituals and clear preparation guidance. It has no physical café, known awards or certified sustainability credentials.
profile.target_audience: US adults aged 25–50 who brew coffee at home, including beginners and casual enthusiasts. Customers value a comforting ritual and approachable explanations rather than technical jargon. Do not make assumptions about work schedules, culture or caffeine needs.
profile.products: Morning Table medium-roast blend: 250 g, $16 USD, whole bean or ground; supplied tasting notes cocoa and toasted almond. Slow Sunday decaf blend: 250 g, $18 USD, whole bean; tasting notes caramel and dried fruit. Everyday ceramic mug: 300 mL, $20 USD, oat and forest green; not claimed dishwasher-safe.

Make room for your everyday ritual.

brands.label: Luma Grove — everyday skincare
brands.summary: A minimal, factual skincare brand for simple daily routines.

profile.tone: Calm, reassuring, clear and factual; no medical language
profile.description: Fictional direct-to-consumer cosmetic skincare brand offering a short, approachable daily routine. Communicates product format, texture and use without promises to treat medical conditions. No clinical studies, certifications, efficacy percentages or dermatologist endorsements are supplied.
profile.target_audience: US adults aged 22–45 who prefer a small, understandable skincare routine. Inclusive across genders and skin appearances. Do not diagnose skin conditions or exploit insecurities; suitability for specific sensitivities is unverified.
profile.products: Soft Start gel cleanser: 150 mL, $18 USD, rinse-off gel in a sage bottle. Daily Layer moisturizer: 50 mL, $24 USD, lightweight cream in an ivory jar.
